name: ARMOR-SOLAR
role: Solar gateway node: the firmware that reads inverters and batteries through up to ten serial ports, its web panel and the protocol library
stack: C++17 (host-tested core); ESP-IDF 5.4 firmware for the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 N16R8 (Wi-Fi) and the Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH (Ethernet); JavaScript web panel
deployment_target: ESP32-S3 gateway nodes: N16R8 on Wi-Fi, or Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH on Ethernet
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host
notes: The firmware builds in the ESP-IDF container and its core is tested on a computer with stand-in equipment; the messages it makes are accepted by ARMOR-COMMON. It has never run on a board and nothing has been connected to a real inverter or battery. The ANT-BMS decoder is tested with frames captured by other people on real units, not by this project.
